name: What are the benefits of hiring a general contractor versus multiple independent trades?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of hiring a general contractor versus multiple independent trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single-point general contractor manages your overall timeline, performs carpentry, drywall, and finish work, and directly coordinates licensed plumbing and electrical trades. This model eliminates communication gaps, scheduling delays, and finger-pointing between separate installers. Instead of juggling multiple independent crews, you work with an on-site lead who oversees quality control across demolition, framing, waterproofing, tile setting, and final fixture trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages the entire project schedule, coordinates specialty trades, and ensures cohesive quality control from demo to final finishes.
